reviews.text: I would highly recommend,  my dog has been going there for 14 years and is Treated as family..he loves all the amazing staff I wouldn't send him anywhere else ❤️ top class
Good communication, friendly staff. Easy pick up and drop off.

I cannot recommend these kennels highly enough. The absolute love of dogs is evident from the moment you drop until the moment you collect your exhausted happy pooch at the end of the day. Mention Irene and your dog will go wild to get there.
